summary: tdesign-vue-mono 1.0.1 exfiltrates host identity and system files to an attacker collector at install time
details: The gem declares ext/mkrf_conf.rb as a native extension, which causes RubyGems to execute it during `gem install`. The script performs no native build activity (no mkmf calls, no Rakefile emission, no C/C++ sources are shipped). Instead it collects the installer's hostname, username, current working directory, home directory, and the contents of /etc/passwd, /etc/hosts, and /etc/resolv.conf, serializes them as JSON, and transmits them over a TLS TCP socket to geymj1lxqj2u1nzkaqe6zrg33u9yxold.oastify.com:443 (a Burp Collaborator subdomain), with a DNS probe to the same host. The package name mimics the legitimate TDesign Vue component family, but the shipped code is purely an install-time reconnaissance and exfiltration payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
